rules.hint: Stock phrase the original does not use; say the specific thing instead.
The same connector appears again within a few sentences; vary it or drop it.
The rewrite uses this connector more often than the original; keep it only if the link is real.
Many dashes for the number of sentences; use commas, parentheses, or a new sentence instead.
Sentences are all about the same length; vary them so the text does not drone.
